rules: Owned by packages/protocol/src/refusal-ledger.test.ts; see specs/done/launch-video-feedback/README.md. codes: every UPPER_SNAKE string literal in product source, with a category and per-file counts. Refusal categories: malformed, ambiguous, conflict, resource-bound, missing-prerequisite, destructive, execution-failure. issue-code: an UPPER_SNAKE diagnostic reported on output (a per-item warning or state), never a refusal; it stays outside the kebab-case issue registry. not-a-refusal: another constant. refusedStatus: files allowed a 'refused' status literal, each for a caller-authored verdict. No quality gate refuses, and no code hides inside a message text.

refusedStatus.packages/composition/src/edits.ts: reads a caller-authored synchronization verdict to report it as an issue
refusedStatus.packages/core/src/alignment-evidence.ts: retained alignment-worker evidence keeps the worker's own verdict word
refusedStatus.packages/core/src/alignment-operands.ts: retained alignment-worker evidence keeps the worker's own verdict word
refusedStatus.packages/core/src/speaker-continuity.ts: an evaluation verdict over measured gates, like synchronization evidence; retained receipts keep it
